primitives.name: Glass Ledger Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: By SHA-256 Merkle-sealing **full probability distributions (`q10..q90`), `C0–C6` conserved stat vectors, and `PASS` decisions** prior to kickoff—and exposing **`POST /api/gse/v1/truth/commit`** so *outside sports creators and AI forecasting teams* can lock and verify their own pre-kickoff predictions—`GSE` owns the **live, non-contaminable measurement standard** (`OpticOdds` / `Moody's` wedge).
primitives.latex: M = \text{MerkleTree}(\{q_{10}, q_{50}, q_{90}, C_0, \dots, C_6, PASS\})
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'M': 'Merkle tree commitment (binary string)', 'q_{10}, q_{50}, q_{90}': 'Quantile estimates (dimensionless probability)', 'C_k': 'Conserved statistical moment (e.g., mean, variance)', 'PASS': 'Boolean flag (True/False)'}
primitives.assumptions: Collision-resistant hash functions, honest majority of verifiers, offline signing key.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When adversarial manipulation corrupts \(\mathcal{D}\), the Merkle root becomes invalid, triggering a \(\text{VERIFICATION_FAILURE}\) event.

layer2.mapping: The glass ledger is mathematically equivalent to a Merkle authentication tree used in blockchain UTXO sets, but applied to probabilistic forecasts rather than transaction histories.
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of sealed distributions that pass independent verification

primitives.name: Zero Claude Routine Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: - `Deal Desk` and `Moonshot Radar` route through your **already-built `stealth-skeleton-brain.ts` / `OpenMuse` / `OmniRoute` multi-provider adapter** (`OpenRouter :free [DeepSeek-R1 / Qwen-2.5]` $\to$ `Grok / xAI` $\to$ `AWS Bedrock $100 Credit` $\to$ `NVIDIA NIM / GCP Vertex`), enforcing `00-TRUTH-FILE.md` via regex AST pre-flight before outputting drafts.
primitives.latex: R_i(t) = f_i(\text{Input}_i, t) + \sum_{j \in \mathcal{M}} w_{ij} R_j(t-\Delta t)
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_i': 'Routine state (arbitrary)', 'f_i': 'Local deterministic update function', 'w_{ij}': 'Message weight between routines', '\\mathcal{M}': 'Multi-provider message bus', 't': 'Time (seconds since epoch)'}
primitives.assumptions: Finite-state automata, bounded computation per time step, asynchronous message passing.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When the Claude endpoint becomes unavailable, the engine switches to a \(\text{DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK}\) mode where only local logic executes.

layer2.mapping: The engine implements a state machine that monitors provider health and dynamically reconfigures its topology to avoid single points of failure.
layer2.telemetry: Mean time between Claude unavailability events affecting revenue-generating paths

primitives.verbatim_quote: --### Workstream 1 (`SHIP FIRST` — Legal `LICENSE`, `sheaf_integrity` Fix, Glass Ledger & Live Week 10 Storefront) #### 1A.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\text{AuditScore}': 'Dimensionless performance metric (higher is better)', 'w_i': 'Weight of individual test (typically 1)', 'n_{\\text{failures}}': 'Number of integrity violations detected', 'N': 'Total number of tests run', '\\lambda': 'Penalty coefficient (set to 2.5 for $2500 auditors)'}

layer2.telemetry: Average audit score across quarterly security assessments
